segments.text: a plane hits a jungle mountain in a storm. She wakes up under a seat, jaw broken, one lung collapsed.
Her fiancé died in the crash. The one man near her still alive dies soon after.
She has no water. Then she sees the broken wing.
Its insulation is soft, like a sponge. She drags herself to it on her elbows and pulls out tufts.
When rain comes, they soak it up. She drinks one sip at a time.
But day after day, nobody finds the wreck.
So she stops panicking. She stays in the moment, and trusts that they will come.
On day eight, a police officer finds her. He thinks she's a ghost. Then rescuers carry her down the mountain.
Thirty people died. She was the only one who lived. Case closed. It all started when
